canonical_hierarchy.rule: One EVSE can serve at most one vehicle at a time; connectors are compatible interfaces and are not independent capacity.

fr_pan_static.connector_representation: boolean capability flags on the EVSE row

rules: Do not infer connector type from power.
Preserve the raw connector value whenever normalized value is unknown.
France connector flags create logical capabilities with nullable connector IDs, not additional EVSEs.
PAN cable_t2_attache had zero known values at capture; do not infer attached Type 2 from other fields.
Parse units and localized decimal separators explicitly.
Quarantine non-positive, below-1-kW and above-1000-kW values pending source review.
Do not sum connector or EVSE rated power into promised site output.
Power is rated maximum and never promised delivered power.
Do not merge operator, network, owner/developer or EMSP into one field.
Normalize aliases only through an auditable mapping while retaining source spelling and code.
A display name is not a durable identity without its source namespace and code.
Status is EVSE-level unless the source explicitly supplies connector condition.
Higher-level out-of-service overrides connector functional state.
Occupied and reserved apply to the whole EVSE because only one connector can be used at once.
RIPREE-only records always have unknown live availability.
Tariff presence does not prove availability.
